steps.title: Check kubectl CLI Setup
steps.description: Check if the kubectl Kubernetes command-line tool is installed in your sandbox.
tasks: Run `kubectl version --client` to verify kubectl is ready

steps.title: Create a Pod Manifest File
steps.description: Write a Kubernetes YAML manifest to define an Nginx pod.
tasks: Create file `/home/student/k8s/pod.yaml` with apiVersion: v1, kind: Pod, and image: nginx

verification.command: grep -q 'kind: Pod' /home/student/k8s/pod.yaml && echo PASS || echo FAIL
